name: Solarpunk
means: Optimistic ecological futurism: white structure overrun with green, glass and water, high clean daylight, plants integrated into architecture rather than decorating it.
tags: solarpunk, lush greenery, white architecture, sunlight, plants, glass, utopian
prose: a bright ecological future of white architecture overgrown with greenery, glass and water, clean high daylight
negative_add: dystopian, ruins, smog, dark, industrial decay
works_for: video - foliage is dense fine detail and is a known i2v boiling case
note: The strongest signal is the LIGHT - high, clean, unclouded - not the word solarpunk.
